add_nodes.name: List Plan Versions

add_nodes._note: No x-upsert header, so an existing object cannot be overwritten.

add_nodes.name: Insert Plan Version
add_nodes._note: status defaults to awaiting_approval. Unique indexes refuse a duplicate version or a second version in flight.
